name: pktbuf
description: Growable packet buffer, TLV record decoder and a handler table dispatched through function pointers (src/pktd.c).

bugs.title: Integer overflow in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` adds the requested size to the current length without an overflow check, so a huge request wraps `need` to a small value and the buffer is not grown.
bugs.poc: Call buf_append() with n = SIZE_MAX - 8 on a buffer holding 16 bytes.

bugs.title: Heap overflow in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` trusts `buf_reserve()` to have grown the buffer, but when the size computation wraps the memcpy writes past the allocation.
bugs.poc: Append a record whose declared length makes len + n wrap around.

bugs.title: Out-of-bounds read in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` copies `n` bytes from the read cursor without checking that `off + n` stays within `len`.
bugs.poc: Consume 64 bytes from a buffer that holds 8.

bugs.title: Unchecked record length in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` takes the 16-bit record length from the wire and never compares it with the bytes remaining, so handlers read `t->len` bytes past the end of the buffer.

bugs.title: Integer underflow in {fn}() bounds check
bugs.summary: Once a bogus record length pushes `off` past `len`, the unsigned subtraction in `{fn}()` wraps and the next iteration parses memory beyond the buffer.
bugs.poc: Two frames, the first declaring a length larger than the data that follows.

bugs.title: Unbounded hex dump in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` writes 2 * len + 1 bytes into `out` without taking the output size, so any long record overflows the caller's buffer.
bugs.poc: Dump a 300-byte record into a 64-byte buffer.

bugs.title: Over-read when echoing ping payload in {fn}()
bugs.summary: The ping handler `{fn}()` echoes `t->len` bytes from `t->value`, and that length was never validated against the received frame.
bugs.poc: Send a type-1 record that declares 4000 bytes but carries 2.

bugs.title: Stack buffer overflow in {fn}()
bugs.summary: The data handler `{fn}()` copies `t->len - 4` bytes into a 512-byte stack array; a record longer than 516 bytes overflows it, and one shorter than 4 underflows the size.
bugs.poc: Send a type-2 record with length 2000.

bugs.title: Out-of-bounds read in legacy framing {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` reads the type and one-byte length and advances the cursor without checking that any of those bytes are present.
bugs.poc: Send a single byte 0x81 as the whole stream.
